filter: serviceName eq 'Virtual Machines' and armSkuName eq 'Standard_D16ads_v5' and armRegionName eq 'westus3'
purchaseModel: regular pay-as-you-go; not Spot or Low Priority
imageMeterNote: The Retail Prices API has no image-version field; this Windows-licensed VM meter is the exact SKU/region purchase-model match for the measured Windows Server image.

natGateway.billingNote: The experiment shared this bootstrap resource across runs. Azure documents that a partial resource hour is billed as a full hour, so it is a fixed experiment cost and is not folded into candidate VM cost.

publicIp.billingNote: Shared only by the NAT gateway; the measured VM itself had no public IP or inbound rule.

managedOsDisk.billingNote: The P10 OS disk was shared across the experiment lifetime and is not folded into candidate VM cost.

medianEightShardArtifactAccounting.note: The payload figure counts one compiled-artifact upload, eight downloads, and one result upload. It is an upper-bound multiplication against the NAT data meter, not a claim about final invoiced byte accounting. Blob capacity and transaction charges are separate and below one tenth of a cent per run at this scale.
